_comment: The Artesiete chain's venues, read off the chain's own venue pages (services.cinemas.es.ArtesieteClient) instead of SensaCine. Hand-kept like ocine.json; generate_own_sources.py turns it into SpanishOwnSourcesData.scala and refuses a theaterId the roster lacks.

Built 2026-10-12 from the chain's own venue list (the `:theaters` prop every artesiete.es page embeds: ID_Centro, name, postcode, GPS, urlredir), matched to the roster by postcode and address: all eleven venues are SensaCine-listed. Artesiete Alhsur (E0722, ID_Centro 26, La Zubia) was dropped on 2026-11-03: the chain no longer lists it, its page stopped answering around 2026-10-15, and it is retired as feedless in retired.json. Two trade under other names on SensaCine: Multicines Úbeda (E0538, the chain's 'MULTICINES Ubeda', Av. de Linares s/n, 23400) and Multicines Bahia Mar (E0491, 'ARTESIETE BAHIA' in CC Bahía Mar, 11500 El Puerto de Santa María).

page: the venue's page on its own subdomain — where www.artesiete.es/Cine/<id>/<slug> redirects. Each embeds every session on sale (`:fullsessionsinfo`), measured 2026-10-12 to reach 2026-12-15..12-20 (two months; SensaCine lists a week to a month), with room and format on every session.

Artesiete Segovia (E0716, the chain's ID_Centro 13, C/ Dámaso Alonso 54, 40006) timed out twice on the first pass (60s, 2026-10-12) and answered in 0.5s on the retry the same day, from the worker's IP too: 108 sessions to 2026-12-23, where SensaCine listed four days.
